items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, HR Management, or related field and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
Master’s degree in related field
5+ years of related experience in graduate medical education, academic program administration, healthcare administration, or related field
Hands-on experience supporting resident or fellowship programs, including accreditation, program reviews, committee administration, and continuous improvement activities
Experience working with ACGME-accredited training programs and related systems such as MedHub, ERAS, NRMP, WebADS, or similar platforms
Experience in an academic medical center, teaching hospital, or higher education environment

The Department of Psychiatry, in partnership with the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior and the Neuropsychiatric Hospital, is a world-renowned leader in psychiatric research, education, and patient care. We are seeking a House Staff Coordinator to support residency and fellowship training programs that prepare the next generation of psychiatrists and physician leaders. Key responsibilities:
Coordinate administrative operations for psychiatry residency and fellowship programs
Support accreditation activities, compliance initiatives, and site visit preparations
Manage trainee onboarding, scheduling, rotations, and educational program logistics
Coordinate committees, meetings, program evaluations, and accreditation documentation
Assist with residency and fellowship recruitment, interview activities, and trainee communications
Maintain program records, databases, and educational technologies, including trainee management systems
Collaborate with faculty, trainees, and institutional partners to support program success and continuous improvement
Proficiency with standard business software and database systems
please note: Skills are subject to testing
Knowledge of graduate medical education (GME) administration, residency and fellowship program operations, and academic medicine environments
Knowledge of accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance processes
Strong organizational, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
